follow-up time: Up to 42 days postpartum for maternal outcomes, up to hospital discharge for neonatal outcomes
exposure: older maternal age at first birth
cohort: 6161 licensed physicians and 211,191 non-physician counterparts residing in high-income areas of Ontario, Canada, who gave birth at 20 or more weeks' gestation between April 1, 2002, and November 26, 2018
finding: While physicians were more likely to experience severe maternal morbidity in unadjusted analyses, this association was not significant after adjusting for maternal age, parity, previous preterm birth, calendar year, immigration status, comorbidities, multiple gestation, and mode of delivery.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was a covariate adjusted for in the analysis.
